note: MEASURED ranked buff durations, one row per EXACT ranked spell name. Nothing here is derived from a rank formula or a mote multiplier - every row cites the observation it came from, and RankedBuffDurationTests fails a row whose baseSeconds does not reproduce its own observedSeconds through BuffDurationModel.WithReinforcement. Curated: never auto-written by the wiki refresh (a wrong duration is worse than none). baseSeconds is the PRE-AA length; the tracker applies the caster's own Spell Casting Reinforcement rank on top, so a player with a different rank gets their own number rather than the measurer's.
